input.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims and related misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently covers only its own breach of this Agreement, leaving us exposed on third-party claims that the Interface, Hosting Services or Support Services infringe IP rights. We have added the standard vendor indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with usual notice and cooperation procedure; if preferred, we can accept an IP-only indemnity with customary exclusions for Client modifications, combinations and specifications.

ops.text: c. In addition, TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable provided by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any copyright, trade secret, trademark, patent or other intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, tender sole control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing liability or admission on the indemnified party shall be made without its consent), and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.
